final_text:
Need versions; get definitions.
The Spotfire "Customer invoiced sales" measure resolves to **Sum(INVOICELINES.EXTENDEDPRICE − INVOICELINES.TAXAMOUNT)**, grouped by CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERNAME and joined through INVOICES. All of these are synthetic files, not real Spotfire or HANA exports.

**Lineage, one step at a time**

| # | Step | Document (doc_id · path · version) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Visual SYN_VIZ_CUSTOMER: value = `Sum([SalesAmount])`, category = `[CUSTOMERNAME]`, data table InvoiceSales, no filters, all loaded dates | CONNECTED_a5086dc0ef985e23 · fixtures/spotfire/customer_sales.metadata.json · 46742043d0c70b3e9492aca16f0c3fc04404c1db0bc14e334978b2674f172357 |
| 2 | Calculated column SalesAmount = `[INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX]`; the InvoiceSales table is loaded from customer_sales.source.sql | same as step 1 |
| 3 | The source query selects INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX and CUSTOMERNAME (plus other fields) from `"SYNTHETIC_SALES"."CV_INVOICE_SALES"` | CONNECTED_1055b17d75582621 · fixtures/spotfire/customer_sales.source.sql · f67352b5a51bba4566da228ea9c31326007138b0e8e05aabca4de2686370f561 |
| 4 | Model CV_INVOICE_SALES (one row per INVOICELINEID): `l.EXTENDEDPRICE - l.TAXAMOUNT AS INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX`; CUSTOMERNAME comes from `c.CUSTOMERNAME`. Joins: INVOICELINES→INVOICES on INVOICEID, INVOICES→CUSTOMERS on CUSTOMERID, INVOICELINES→STOCKITEMS on STOCKITEMID. All are inner joins, many-to-one | CONNECTED_c321fb5572f5ed86 · fixtures/hana/CV_INVOICE_SALES.model.xml · d33d0ec9211725e359b399623b46396df45aca42fac9800473bebb08cc061ce3 |

**Backed by the source files**
- SalesAmount → INVOICED_SALES_EX_TAX → INVOICELINES.EXTENDEDPRICE − INVOICELINES.TAXAMOUNT
- CUSTOMERNAME → CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERNAME, reached through INVOICELINES.INVOICEID = INVOICES.INVOICEID and INVOICES.CUSTOMERID = CUSTOMERS.CUSTOMERID
- The join to STOCKITEMS is inner. It doesn't change the measure's definition, but it would drop invoice lines that have no matching stock item.

**Missing or not backed**
- **Physical schema:** the model lists bare table names (INVOICELINES, INVOICES, CUSTOMERS, STOCKITEMS) with no database or schema. A separate catalog entry, the "Customer invoiced sales" report view (doc CUSTOMER_INVOICE_SALES), uses HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.* with the same formula. But that view isn't part of the Spotfire chain, and I haven't read it in full or recorded its path or version. So linking the model's tables to RAW is an assumption.
- **Customer key:** the visual groups by CUSTOMERNAME, which is only a label. Customers with the same name would be added together. The report view treats CUSTOMERID as the customer's identity instead.
- **Other files:** I didn't check whether a HANA SQL version of CV_INVOICE_SALES exists alongside the XML model.
- **Not modelled:** currency, discounts, returns and cancellations. The business definitions say ExtendedPrice includes tax, which is why tax is subtracted.

This was a trace only. I didn't propose, build, validate or release a candidate.
